entries.text: Battles are like mountains in winter—the situation\ncan change in a heartbeat.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.text: You’re always just one step away from\ndevastation... The cold will leave you shaking.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_01_01
entries.text: Art is creation and destruction! Struggle, else\nyour defeat will nourish my Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_01_02
entries.text: This has promise! Yes! Let us lead this artistic\nendeavor to its conclusion at once![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_01_03
entries.text: Allow me to touch this work up slightly! I will call\nit...“Truleewoodo”![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_01_04
entries.text: At times, art becomes a race against the clock!\nLet us increase the pace![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_01_01
entries.text: I feel a bit indebted to ya, but don’t expect me\nto go easy on ya just ’cause o’ that![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_01_02
entries.text: The tides ebb and flow! It’s time for a raging\ntidal surge![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_01_03
entries.text: Prepare the rigging for a big transformation!\nMy Pokémon’s gon’ rock the boat![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_01_04
entries.text: One ol’ man Kofu special, comin’ right up! Hang\non tight or get swept away by the Surging Chef![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_01_01
entries.text: Don’t take my Bug-type Pokémon lightly. You will\nbe in for a world of pain if you do![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_01_02
entries.text: Oh? You’re quite good, aren’t you. How should\nI roll things out from here?[VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_01_03
entries.text: Now, my little Pokémon! Time to break free from\nyour cocoon and come into your own![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_01_04
entries.text: Feast your eyes on my shining bug decoration!\nThough this one is not so sweet![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_01_01
entries.text: I just ate, so...let’s not go too hard.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_01_02
entries.text: This is still better than getting cornered by\nmy boss.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_01_04
entries.text: I think it’s time to show you that real life isn’t all\njust being true to yourself...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_jimen_01_01
entries.text: I finally get to battle you! I’ve been looking\nforward to this, so don’t you give up too soon![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_jimen_01_02
entries.text: Nahahaha! Impressive! You really are something\nelse, kiddo![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_jimen_01_03
entries.text: Let’s finish this! Go on, Clodsire! Shake things up\na bit![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_jimen_01_04
entries.text: Watch your step, ’cause things are about to get\na bit shaky![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hagane_01_02
entries.text: I’m not scared! My last Pokémon will turn\nthings around![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hagane_01_03
entries.text: It’s time to get dressed up all pretty, Tinkie![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hagane_01_04
entries.text: Steel-hard Pokémon always get a solid victory!\nSo I’m gonna win![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hikou_01_01
entries.text: Well, I’ll be trying my hand with Flying-type\nPokémon this time...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hikou_01_02
entries.text: You’re even stronger than before. Guess I don’t\nget a break today...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hikou_01_03
entries.text: At the risk of messing up my suit a bit...it’s time\nto get some wind at our backs.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_hikou_01_04
entries.text: I’d advise you to stay on your toes, because I’m\nabout to scatter you to the wind![VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_01_01
entries.text: Show me everything you’ve got. I shall face you\nwith my full strength![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_01_02
entries.text: Only a little more until you pass! Don’t let up![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_01_03
entries.text: Come, O great dragon, and take a Tera Jewel as\nyour crown![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_01_04
entries.text: No point in letting this drag on... Behold, the\npower to overwhelm everything![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_01
entries.text: I do hope you can defeat me and become\na Champion yourself.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_02
entries.text: This is how you’re supposed to unleash a move.\nThis is what it takes to be at the top.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_03
entries.text: Heh! Hahahahahaha! Don’t think you’ve won\njust yet![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_04
entries.text: Yes, that was the correct decision in this situation.\nPlease continue.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_05
entries.text: What’s the matter? You’re not one to let\nsomething so insignificant fluster you.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_06
entries.text: Truly a devastating blow. That deserves a\nstanding ovation.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_07
entries.text: Oh, a critical hit... Poor thing.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_01_10
entries.text: Be the light that guides all Trainers, Glimmora.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_00_01
entries.text: These memories are leaving a bad taste in my\nmouth—and I want it gone![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_01_02
entries.text: The Pokémon that I met during our hunt for the\nHerba Mystica are all stars—every one of them![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_01_03
entries.text: Let’s celebrate your full recovery with a glow up!\nTime to Terastallize, Mabosstiff![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_01_01
entries.text: You don’t really think things through, do ya?\nDeclarin’ war on Team Star is a real bad move.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_01_02
entries.text: Ha! How’s that for an openin’ track?! I’ll spin you\nup good, party crasher![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_01_03
entries.text: This beat drop’ll bust your ears open! DJ Vice\nbringin’ the house dooown![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_01_04
entries.text: Time to up the tempo! This show ain’t over yet![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_01_01
entries.text: Naught but punishment awaits thee, wretch!\nA plague on your house![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_01_02
entries.text: Certain moves can poison with a mere graze.\nTremble, scoundrel, for thy Pokémon’s sake.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_01_03
entries.text: This next move is as splendid as it is insidious—\nbehold as it gnaws its target away![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_01_04
entries.text: You think to give me a taste of mine own poison?\nFie! I will fight on till the bitter end![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_01_01
entries.text: I promise I’ll play nice, so don’t blame me when\nthis battle sends you blubbering back home![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_01_02
entries.text: Oopsie. Did you just realize how outmatched\nyou are? If you wanna give up, now’s the time![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_01_03
entries.text: Have a taste of this slick move! Betcha can’t\nhandle my Pokémon’s adorable strength![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_01_04
entries.text: What the HECK?! Why is MY team on the ropes?\nThat’s totally not fair![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_kakutou_boss_01_01
entries.text: This base is precious to us! I won’t let this raid\nof yours go any further![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_kakutou_boss_01_02
entries.text: I give as good as I get—that’s a promise!\nWe’ll see who’s left standing in the end![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_kakutou_boss_01_04
entries.text: I...I refuse to lose! So please...lend me your\nstrength.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_honoo_boss_01_01
entries.text: Right here, right now... You’re going down.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_honoo_boss_01_02
entries.text: THAT was for the rest of the Schedar Squad![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_honoo_boss_01_03
entries.text: This move’ll torch ya till there ain’t nothin’ but\nash left![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_honoo_boss_01_04
entries.text: Tch! I ain’t burned to a crisp just yet![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_kusa_01
entries.text: I am Cassiopeia of Team Star! With this battle,\nI will finally bring Operation Starfall to an end![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_kusa_02
entries.text: Very well... It seems I shall have to Terastallize\nmy Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_kusa_03
entries.text: Heh. To think that I, Cassiopeia, would be\nbacked into a corner like this.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_clavel_01_kusa_04
entries.text: Do take a step back, please. This may get\ndangerous.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.text: I won’t hold back in this battle! I’ll stay true to\nTeam Star’s code![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_01_02
entries.text: Time to Terastallize! Shine bright like the starry\nsky and become who you really want to be![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_01_03
entries.text: I can’t fault you on your battle skills at all.\nNo wonder the bosses fell at your hands.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_01_04

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_02_01
entries.text: Time to put on my serious face! Eyes wide open\nlike a Magnemite so you don’t miss a thing![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_02_03
entries.text: Come fooorth, shiny li’l lightbulb! Be the\ninvention that leads me to victory! Bzzzzzzt![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_denki_leader_02_04
entries.text: Zap! Rock, paper, pew pew pew! Come on out\nif yer weak to Electric stuff![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_02_01
entries.text: You want to know the secret to my beauty? I’ll\nenroll you in my most difficult hands-on course.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_02_02
entries.text: I’m shook—and not in a good way. Unpleasant\nsurprises are NOT good for my skin.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_02_03
entries.text: Come here, my little Florges! It’s time for a skin\ncleanse. You’ll become a new you![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_esper_leader_02_04
entries.text: First, you must be beautiful! In the end, strength\nfavors beauty.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_02_01
entries.text: C’mon, rookie! Show me you deserve to be\ncalled a Champion![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_02_02
entries.text: Hangin’ on by the skin of my teeth! Gotta make\nthis count![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_02_03
entries.text: This ghostly change’ll turn your highs to lows!\nThe brightest lights cast the darkest shadows![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_02_04
entries.text: You think I’m down and out? I’m about to turn\nyour world upside-down![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_02_01
entries.text: Conditions are...all right, I guess. Good enough\nto defeat you, anyway.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_02_02
entries.text: I won’t let things heat up any further. Time to\nbring the deep freeze.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_02_03
entries.text: Let it freeze. Let it snow. Let it pile up on top\nof us.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_koori_leader_02_04
entries.text: I think you’re getting a little hotheaded. Let me\ncool you down with this move![VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_02_01
entries.text: Let us ponder the art we will create together,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_02_02
entries.text: This work’s concept is the deep-rooting nature of\nplants! A briar’s thorns are not easily removed![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_02_03
entries.text: I do hope this work lives up to my expectations!\nI shall call it “Truleewoodo Part Two”![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_kusa_leader_02_04
entries.text: My dear grass...grow, I say! Heed my wishes\nand grow![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_02_01
entries.text: Good ingredients don’t need no cover-up spices!\nGet ready for fresh, raw ol’ man Kofu![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_02_02
entries.text: Gahaha! Batten down the hatches and prepare\nfor a storm! This’s what makes battling excitin’![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_02_03
entries.text: A Crabominable Terastallizing! Think outside\nthe crab trap, I say![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mizu_leader_02_04
entries.text: Better get a big breath o’ air, ’cause yer about to\nget hit by a surgin’ wave![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_02_01
entries.text: Don’t expect me to be sweet today! And don’t\ncry when you taste bitter defeat![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_02_02
entries.text: Perseverance is important for Bug types! It’s time\nto leap toward victory![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_02_03
entries.text: My sweet little bear! Show me your new form as\nif you were a bug emerging from its cocoon![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_mushi_leader_02_04
entries.text: I’ll smash you like a cake with this decorative\nmove! What do you think of this dessert?![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_02_01
entries.text: The boss takes some getting used to, you know.\nYou’ve got your work cut out for you...[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_02_02
entries.text: You’re just plain strong, aren’t you? But I always\noutput my best results when it’s crunch time.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_02_03
entries.text: Time to show what we can really do. Same good\nwork as always, please.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_normal_leader_02_04
entries.text: I hope you find the power of this next move\nto be satisfactory.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_02_01
entries.text: I want you and me to be on the same level...\nSo I’m going after this win without holding back![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_02_02
entries.text: I’m putting everything I’ve got into this...\nNo regrets allowed—no leftovers after this meal![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_02_03
entries.text: Let’s light up this School Battle Brawl, Mabosstiff!\nBrighter than anybody![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_02_04
entries.text: Let’s put those great jaws to good use, bud!\nWe’re gonna chew up h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]iser hopes of victory![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_01_01
entries.text: Show me what you’ve got—in your own way and\nat your own pace.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_01_02
entries.text: Wow! You sure are strong! Is there some secret in\nthe way you raise your Pokémon?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_01_03
entries.text: Just a little energy and there you have it!\nNow watch as my Pokémon Terastallizes.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_01_04
entries.text: Let’s try something a little different. I wonder\nwhat effect this will have on the battle.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_01_01
entries.text: Let’s have a good, clean battle, OK?\nBest of luck![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_01_02
entries.text: You’ve got real fight in you, new kid! This battle’s\nreally stoked my fighting spirit![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_01_03
entries.text: Aim to push past your limits day by day! Osu![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_01_04
entries.text: Give it your all! That’ll make the taste of victory\neven sweeter![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_02_01
entries.text: Let us set an example for everyone, you and I.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_02_02
entries.text: We’ll make this match a fitting one for the finale.\nA grand spectacle![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_02_03
entries.text: May you shine as brightly as the future of\nPaldea, Glimmora![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_02_04
entries.text: Being strong is a given for a Champion. You must\nalso learn to give the audience a show![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_03_01
entries.text: Think you’ve got us on the run? Not at all, little\nbuddy—this is when we turn it around and shine![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_03_02
entries.text: Mabosstiff, time to Terastallize! No one can ever\noutshine you![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_pepper_03_03
entries.text: Now’s our chance! Show ’em how strong you are![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_02_01
entries.text: You always have to go all-out, don’t you?\n...In a good way, I mean.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_botan_02_02
entries.text: Time to Terastallize! Become who you really want\nto be, and shine like the twinkling stars![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_02_01
entries.text: I’m not gonna give up that easily! Time to give it\neverything I’ve got and more![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_02_02
entries.text: Smash through your limits! Tell them\nTerastallizing is here![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kihada_02_03
entries.text: Time to attack head on like a hot-blooded\nhurricane![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_taimu_01_01
entries.text: Six minus five... Only one Pokémon left! But with\n10 times the strength, I may as well have 10![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_taimu_01_02
entries.text: Garganacl, be a dear and square up a bit more,\nif you would.[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_taimu_01_03
entries.text: Ah! This is so fun! Or as the kids would say, this\n“rocks”! And I guess it’s time to rock your world![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rehoru_01_01
entries.text: How about taking a page from the history books\nand allowing me to pull victory from defeat?[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rehoru_01_02
entries.text: It’s time to use the technology born of the Great\nCrater! Primeval power, spill forth![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_rehoru_01_03
entries.text: It’s time to put the history written by you and\nyour Pokémon to the test![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_mimoza_01_01
entries.text: What? You gotta be kidding me! Am I seriously\ndown to my last Pokémon?![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_mimoza_01_02
entries.text: Let’s do this, Toxapex! It’s your time to shine![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_mimoza_01_03
entries.text: Here comes a big one! Don’t worry—I’ll get you\nsome medicine afterward![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sawaro_01_01
entries.text: I will remain calm despite the circumstances.\nI must stand firm![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sawaro_01_02
entries.text: Let us do this...adorably. Hatterene, it is time\nto Terastallize.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sawaro_01_03
entries.text: Though you are a student, I cannot go easy on\nyou—especially seeing as you are a Champion.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_02_01
entries.text: Yep, you sure are strong! I need you to share\nyour Pokémon-raising secrets with me.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_02_02
entries.text: We’re all ready to Terastallize! Time to activate\nmy Tera Orb.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zinia_02_03
entries.text: How about this move, then? I think it will be at\nleast somewhat effective.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_seizi_01_01
entries.text: I should not be the one saying au revoir to the\naudience after this battle... That should be you![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_seizi_01_02
entries.text: Do you want to see what I’m capable of? You do,\ndon’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_seizi_01_03
entries.text: Pokémon moves are just another form of\ncommunication! Consider this a greeting![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_02_01
entries.text: The final match is at its climax! Allow me to add\na flourish of color to its glorious conclusion![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_02_02
entries.text: Only a dragon deserves a throne at the top!\nYour brilliant color will outshine all others![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_e4_dragon_02_03
entries.text: A Dragon type with even more dragon now!\nRepetition of patterns can create great art![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_03_01
entries.text: I see you haven’t been slacking off. You’re an\ninspiration to all Champions of Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_03_02
entries.text: Become the light that shines on all who reach\nthe pinnacle, Glimmora.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_chairperson_03_03
entries.text: This is what it means to face the Top Champion!\nLet’s see if you can make it past me![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_01_01
entries.text: Wow! This battle’s amazing! I’m gonna call my\nfriends to come cheer you on!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_02_01
entries.text: That Trainer might actually be really good!\nC’mon! You can do it!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_02_02
entries.text: Whoa! [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe just barely held on! This is some\nwhite-knuckle battling!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_03_01
entries.text: That move was really great! Consider me your\nnewest fan!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_03_02
entries.text: I bet that kid’s going to do something really wild\nfrom here! I know [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she will!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_03_03
entries.text: Nice move choice! [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe’s really sledgin’ up\nMC Sledge!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_05
entries.text: Show us an awesome battle, Ryme! And you too,\nstudent kid!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_06
entries.text: One of Ryme’s Pokémon went down! Woo!\nThis is so exciting!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_07
entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe’s holding out against Ryme’s offensive!\nCome on! You can do it!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_08
entries.text: Nice! [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe totally nailed that Pokémon’s weakness\nwithout batting an eye!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_09
entries.text: Awesome! That was perfect timing to Terastallize!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_10
entries.text: Yeah! It’s a vibe now! Put your hands uuup!\nRyme! Ryme! Ryme!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_11
entries.text: Throw a better rap right back at ’em! Ryme!\nRyme! Ryme!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_12
entries.text: Awww snap, a supereffective move! That’s so\ntight! Ryme! Ryme! Ryme!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_gym_ghost_leader_01_13
entries.text: Ghost Terastallization is the bomb! You’re really\nkillin’ it, Ryme!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_02_01
entries.text: Welcome to the main stage! DJ Vice here,\nkickin’ off today’s sessioooooon![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_02_03
entries.text: Heads up, bud—it’s about to get evil up in here!\nYou won’t learn nothin’ if I hold back, after all![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_aku_boss_02_04
entries.text: Should’ve known this’d turn into a battle of the\nbands. Sucks for you the audience is on my side![VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_02_01
entries.text: There is no night nor day that I do not spend\nin training! Behold the fruits of my labor![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_02_03
entries.text: I shall show thee the truest essence of poison!\nTremble ’fore its grim and deadly beauty![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_doku_boss_02_04
entries.text: Even a single drop of poison can kill! ’Tis far too\nearly to rest assured of thy victory.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_02_01
entries.text: This time, I’ll wipe that smug look off your face\nfor sure! You’re going down![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_02_03
entries.text: You ready for more of my slick, adorable moves?\n’Cause this one’s gonna be pure torture![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_fairy_boss_02_04
entries.text: WHAT?! Am I LOSING?! You’re too good at this!\nIt’s so unfair![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_kakutou_boss_02_03
entries.text: When facing down a foe, there’s only one thing\nto do—push for victory with everything you have![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_kakutou_boss_02_04
entries.text: I focus best when I’m in a tight spot! I’ll show you\nI can still win![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_honoo_boss_02_01
entries.text: You’re a weird one too, aren’tcha? But y’know\nwhat, forget it... Let’s do this.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_honoo_boss_02_03
entries.text: Aight, you asked for it. I’m blowin’ this battle up![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dan_honoo_boss_02_04
entries.text: Heh, you lit a red-hot fire under me.\nNot bad, pal![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.text: O-oh. You know about type matchups, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_04
entries.text: So, do you NOT know about type matchups?\nMaybe you should study up![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_01_05

entries.text: Wowzers... I can’t believe this... I get to battle\nyou! This is awesome![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_01_02
entries.text: Oof, ehehe... I guess I got a lot of weaknesses...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.text: But that was just one attack! Aw man, it did so\nmuch damage...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_02_05

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_01
entries.text: Feel free to be dazzled by how great I look\nin my jinbei. I’ll win while you’re distracted![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_02
entries.text: Is this about the mask?! C’mon, stop with the\nsupereffective moves![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_03
entries.text: Don’t get smug just ’cause you scored a critical\nhit! I’m not panicking or anything![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_02_04
entries.text: I’m gonna crush you and go to the festival feeling\nlike a WINNER![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.text: You think you’re so cool, landing critical hits...\nI’m not giving up my title as leader, OK?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuzaru_01_01_02
entries.text: I wonder if it’ll go all red in the face if we give it\na good trouncing. Time to find out!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuzaru_01_01_03
entries.text: Yes, excellent move! Keep up the pressure!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuzaru_01_01_04
entries.text: Hehehe... Someone’s got a weakness! We can\njust keep using that move till it faints, then!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokuzaru_01_01_05
entries.text: Hehehe... Looks like that move stung! Guess it\nmusta hit somewhere sensitive!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokukizi_01_01_02
entries.text: I know we’re enemies, but its face is so pretty!\nDoesn’t it remind you of me a little?

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokukizi_01_01_03
entries.text: Hey! I’m gonna be the one who deals more\ndamage—you got that?!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokukizi_01_01_04
entries.text: Great job! I knew I could count on my best\ngrunt—er, I mean friend!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_onitaizi_dokukizi_01_01_05
entries.text: That’s what you get for picking on Ogerpon!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_01
entries.text: I know you’re probably a better Trainer for\nOgerpon, but I...I...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_02
entries.text: You’re not holding back... Thank you. But I won’t\nhold back either![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_03
entries.text: Guess luck isn’t on my side... But it doesn’t\nmatter—I got this![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_04
entries.text: It’s not over yet! I...I’m tired of losing![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_05
entries.text: It doesn’t matter how strong my opponent is!\nThis attack’ll get ’em every time![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_01_05_06
entries.text: It doesn’t matter how strong my opponent is... I\ngotta face ’em head on! Get ’em with your wings![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kamenoni_01_01_02
entries.text: Look at you, adapting to Ogerpon’s type! I knew\nyou could handle this.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kamenoni_01_01_04
entries.text: You can’t catch it yet! You need to show Ogerpon\nmore of what you can do![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kamenoni_01_01_05
entries.text: I think that’s everything Ogerpon’s got! Now’s\nyour chance to catch it![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kamenoni_01_01_06
entries.text: It Terastallized its mask! So this is what Ogerpon’s\nreally capable of...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_01
entries.text: You made me wake up early for this, you know!\nYou’d better make it worth my time![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_02
entries.text: Yeesh, you really hit where it hurts, don’t you?\nI bet you’re REAL popular back home![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_03
entries.text: Ugh, that critical hit came out of nowhere!\nI coulda sworn it was gonna be a regular hit![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_04
entries.text: Don’t blame me if Ogerpon changes its mind\nand wants to join up with me after this![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_05
entries.text: Time to stir things up a bit. Better be on your\nguard, or else this move will getcha![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_01_03_06
entries.text: Time to stir things up a bit. Better be on your\nguard, or else this move will getcha![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_01
entries.text: Gimme a nice heroic expression, would you?\nI’ll take a real good shot if you do![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_02
entries.text: Nice moves, kiddo! Glad to see you’re not\ndistracted by the camera![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_03
entries.text: Oof! That was a serious hit. I nearly dropped my\ncamera in shock![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_04
entries.text: How about a new challenger? This one won’t be\neasy to beat![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_05
entries.text: Come on, Leafeon! Let’s take the ultimate shot![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_camera_01_01_06
entries.text: Come on, Leafeon! Let’s take the ultimate shot![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_ariados_01_01_02
entries.text: Argh! What a time for my legs to give out, with\nthis great photo op right in front of me![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_ariados_01_01_03
entries.text: Hey, are things heating up over there? Snap a\ncouple shots for me, would you![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_akatuki_01_01_02
entries.text: This is great—I’m right up close to the action!\nKeep it going while I snap some shots![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_akatuki_01_01_03
entries.text: Oooh, that’s a new expression! This is wonderful!\nThere’s so much good stuff to capture![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_akatuki_01_01_04
entries.text: The Bloodmoon Beast is weak! Now’s your\nchance to catch it, partner![VAR 0x0114(0046)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_system_ogre_01
entries.text: Memories of adventuring with you grant\nOgerpon strength!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_system_ogre_02
entries.text: Memories of working together to retrieve the\nmasks grant Ogerpon strength!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_system_ogre_03
entries.text: Memories of a partner from long, long ago\ngrant Ogerpon strength!

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_01_01
entries.text: I suppose I’m representing Blueberry Academy in\nthis battle. I’ll try not to disappoint![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_01_02
entries.text: Oh, would you look at that! You go right after\nthose type weaknesses with precision, don’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_01_03
entries.text: That was quite the harsh blow! Let’s see...\nNow how should I turn this around...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_01_04
entries.text: Looks like my Plus-Minus strategy isn’t working.\nGuess it’s time to go all out with pure strength![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_01_05
entries.text: Excadrill, sweetie! Let’s shake them to their core![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_01
entries.text: I’ll give you a special treat since you came all\nthis way! Get ready to eat Terarium dirt![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_02
entries.text: Hey, stop that! Why don’t you use one of those\nnot-very-effective moves sometimes?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_03
entries.text: There you go with the big hits! Maybe I should\nteach you a lesson or two in kindness, hm?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_04
entries.text: That’s it—I’m ready to go all out! Heh heh...\nTime for me to Tera it up![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_05
entries.text: Go on, Sinistcha! Give ’em a nice blast of matcha\nfor me![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_sister_02_01_06
entries.text: Oh hey, Ogerpon! Aww, you must’ve really\nmissed me, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_honoo4_02_01_01
entries.text: Now then, time to get cooking—wait, no! Time to\nstart battling![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_honoo4_02_01_02
entries.text: Gwah! You’re really gonna douse our flames if\nyou keep using moves like that![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_honoo4_02_01_03
entries.text: Huh? Wait, what happened?! Where’d all that\ndamage come from?![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_honoo4_02_01_04
entries.text: Time to Terastallize and really turn up the heat!\nGo on, Blaziken! Burn bright red![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_honoo4_02_01_05
entries.text: Hope you’re hungry, ’cause Crispin’s flaming-hot\nspecial is coming right atcha![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_hagane4_02_01_01
entries.text: Get ready, Skarmory. You too, Dugtrio. We’re\nfinishing this battle right on schedule.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_hagane4_02_01_02
entries.text: An unfavorable type matchup... You caught me\noff guard—now my glasses have fogged up.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_hagane4_02_01_03
entries.text: So bad luck can also play a role in battles...\nThat’s good to know. Thank you.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_hagane4_02_01_04
entries.text: ...Time is short. Let’s wrap this battle up.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_hagane4_02_01_05
entries.text: The more health a Pokémon has left, the more it\nwill suffer from this move. You’ve been warned.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_02_01
entries.text: This time I’ll be facing you with my usual party as\na member of the Elite Four.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_02_02
entries.text: It’s a rock-solid strategy to go after weaknesses...\nwhich is why I’ll be turning it right back on you![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_02_03
entries.text: Why did you have to land that kind of hit?\nNow that’s just not right![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_02_04
entries.text: All eyes on our great big Terastal heart! Time to\nget even cuter and cuter![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_fairy4_02_02_05
entries.text: Get ’em, Excadrill! Let’s send them flying with\nyour adorable destructive force![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dragon4_02_01_01
entries.text: Don’t let me down, bud! No one wants to see me\nugly cry.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dragon4_02_01_02
entries.text: Whoa! Not a lot of types can make me eat a\nsupereffective hit.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dragon4_02_01_03
entries.text: Whew! That was beautiful. Seems like luck itself\nhas a soft spot for you![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dragon4_02_01_04
entries.text: Now watch this dragon’s blood boil! Take control,\nArchaludon![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dragon4_02_01_05
entries.text: Ready to get blasted to smithereens? I won’t\nleave you anywhere to run![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_01
entries.text: I know I’m making the right choice... You’ll\nunderstand that soon enough![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_02
entries.text: How do you like that? See how hard I’ve trained?\nNot like the kid you battled in Kitakami, huh?![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_03
entries.text: Ack, wowzers... Doesn’t matter if the type\nmatchups work out for you, though—I’ll still win![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_04
entries.text: Even luck’s chosen you over me... It’s not fair!\nIt’s JUST NOT FAIR!!![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_05
entries.text: I don’t need the old me anymore! I’ve changed...\nand I’ll show you I can change again![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_06
entries.text: Just go down already! How are you still standing\nafter I’ve thrown everything I have at you?![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_07
entries.text: I’m capable of winning too, you know... Victory\nwill be mine and mine alone!!![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_01_08
entries.text: You’ve got some nerve... Bringing out the ogre\nNOW of all times?![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_02
entries.text: Huh, it has a weakness? I thought this was the\nhidden treasure of Area Zero?![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_03
entries.text: How can you get critical hits, even at a time like\nthis... What are you, the hero of this story?![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_04
entries.text: Isn’t it amazing?! C’mon, hidden treasure, unleash\nyour full power for me!!![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_05
entries.text: So this is the hidden treasure’s true form?!\nWith this...I can win for sure![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_brother_02_02_06
entries.text: Terapagos’s power should be far greater than\nthis. Could it be...we’re missing something?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_01_02
entries.text: Its energy output is going haywire! We’re all in\nserious danger if we can’t bring it under control![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_01_03
entries.text: I’m sorry, kids, but please...you need to stop\nTerapagos![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_01
entries.text: C’mon, Kiki, you need to do something too!\nWe’ve got to get Terapagos under control![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_01_01
entries.text: N-no... This wasn’t supposed to happen... This is\nall my fault![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_02
entries.text: It’s using a barrier to reduce damage?! In that\ncase, [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Terastallizing[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] your Pokémon might help![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_03
entries.text: Now’s your chance! Use Terastallized Pokémon to\nstrike back![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_04
entries.text: Oh no, my Sinistcha’s knocked out! This isn’t\ngood... It’s just too strong![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_06
entries.text: I’m so sorry! All my Pokémon are knocked out![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_07
entries.text: It put up another barrier of such strength?! Did\nit use the Terastal energy it absorbed to do so?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_07_01
entries.text: You need to get in there and battle, Kiki!\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)] is doing all the work![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_09_01
entries.text: It absorbed Terastal energy yet again?! Surely it\ncan’t keep doing that over and over, though...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_09_02
entries.text: B-but... I can’t... I can’t help anyone...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_10_01
entries.text: Honestly... Better late than never, I guess! The\ntwo of you need to clean this whole mess up![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_11
entries.text: It looks like it can’t absorb any more energy or\nput up another barrier! Time to attack![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_11_01
entries.text: Time to end this, you two! You have my\npermission to go all out![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_12
entries.text: Maybe it’ll go inside a ball now![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kodaikame_02_01_14
entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I know I can count on you,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].
You
got this![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zombie_man_02_01_02
entries.text: Wh-what’s with them all of a sudden?! Why are\nthey attacking us?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zombie_man_02_01_03
entries.text: I feel bad about it, but the only thing we can do\nis battle them until they calm down...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zombie_old_02_01_02
entries.text: Grandpa! Grandma! Wh-what’s gotten into you?![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_zombie_old_02_01_03
entries.text: Aw man, why’d this have to happen... I guess\nwe’ve got no choice but to beat ’em...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dokutaro_02_01_02
entries.text: Y-you damaged it! That means you can beat it!\nKeep it up—you got this![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dokutaro_02_01_03
entries.text: Aw man, I can’t hold out much longer... Hurry up\nand finish it, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_dokutaro_02_01_04
entries.text: Look—it’s slowing down! Now’s your chance!\nCatch it in a Poké Ball![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_denki_leader_01_01
entries.text: My view count’s on the rise like a super-fast\nEelektross crawlin’ outta the ocean! Nyehehe![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_denki_leader_01_02
entries.text: Come fooorth, shiny li’l lightbulb! No one buzzes\nas super-duper bright as you![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_denki_leader_01_03
entries.text: Zap! Rock, paper, pew pew pew! Get ready to\nplay hide-and-go-BZZT![VAR 0x0114(0019)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_esper_leader_01_01
entries.text: I become all the more beautiful when faced with\nadversity, you know.[VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_esper_leader_01_02
entries.text: They call me the Bewitching Beautician! No\nlooking away—not even for a second![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_esper_leader_01_03
entries.text: Uh-oh. Is your posture slipping? We’ll straighten\nyou out...it’ll be très psy-chic![VAR 0x0114(001C)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_ghost_leader_01_01
entries.text: We’re near the endin’—feel the tension risin’?\nMake your peace now, ’cause you ain’t survivin’![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_ghost_leader_01_02
entries.text: Step to me, I’ll make you take a knee!\nToxtricity, drop the bass in a minor key![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_ghost_leader_01_03
entries.text: Check my Hex—I’ll vex all your careful plans!\nI’m death on two legs. You don’t stand a chance![VAR 0x0114(001B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_koori_leader_01_01
entries.text: It’d be way uncool if I wiped out without putting\nup a fight... I’ll dial up the effort a bit more.[VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_koori_leader_01_02
entries.text: Let the snow fall and pile up—let it obscure our\nweaknesses![VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_koori_leader_01_03
entries.text: Time for a chilling move. Don’t blame me if it\nfreezes you to your core![VAR 0x0114(001A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_kusa_leader_01_01
entries.text: Good! Very avant-garde! Continue creating more\nart in this vein![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_kusa_leader_01_02
entries.text: Let us make hay while the sun shines! I dub this\nmasterpiece: “Truleewoodo Forever”![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_kusa_leader_01_03
entries.text: Time to pick up the pace! A Trainer like you\nought to be able to keep up—but will you?![VAR 0x0114(0017)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mizu_leader_01_01
entries.text: Gahahaha! The tides o’ battle are fickle! Ya never\nknow how they’ll flow—and that’s what I like![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mizu_leader_01_02
entries.text: Prepare the rigging for a big transformation!\nThe tide’s gonna flow my way now![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mizu_leader_01_03
entries.text: The flow o’ water can crush boulders! Why don’t\nya see for yerself?![VAR 0x0114(0018)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mushi_leader_01_01
entries.text: Grit and perseverance—that’s what Bug types are\nall about! We’re turning this battle on its head![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mushi_leader_01_02
entries.text: Decoration time, my little Ursaring! Let’s get you\nsome antennae and bug you up![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_mushi_leader_01_03
entries.text: If you don’t do something about this next attack,\nI think you’ll be sorry! Hehe![VAR 0x0114(0016)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_normal_leader_01_01
entries.text: I’ll see this battle through to the end...unless that\nmeans I have to work overtime.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_normal_leader_01_02
entries.text: There’s nothing wrong with plain and simple.\nLet’s keep things Normal.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_gym_normal_leader_01_03
entries.text: Here’s a crucial skill for anyone in the workforce!\n...That sounds pretty bleak when I say it out loud.[VAR 0x0114(0015)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_pepper_01_01
entries.text: You’re pressing me real hard, but I’ve still got\nthis—’cause I’ve got my loyal partner here![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_pepper_01_02
entries.text: Mabosstiff, you know what’s coming! Shine as\nbright as anything, bud![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_pepper_01_03
entries.text: Bite ’em to pieces with those sturdy molars! Time\nfor all that daily brushing to pay off![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_botan_01_01
entries.text: Oof, I’m in a bind here. I can’t believe I’m down\nto my last Veevee![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_botan_01_02
entries.text: Terastallize like the twinkling stars! You can be\nwhoever you want to be![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_botan_01_03
entries.text: Hope you’re ready for our starlit Veevee power!\nThis time it’s OUR turn for an all-out raid![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_kihada_01_01
entries.text: I don’t give up so easy! I’ll put my spirit into this\nosu! Osu! Osu!!![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_kihada_01_02
entries.text: Harness the power in those balled-up fists and\nget your blood running hot! Terastallize![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_kihada_01_03
entries.text: Let’s go! Body ’em! Forget about defenses—go\nall offense![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_taimu_01_01
entries.text: We aren’t defeated if our team’s value isn’t yet\nzero. Come on, partner. You’re my rock![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_taimu_01_02
entries.text: I’ll multiply my Rock type by a Rock-type\nTerastallization! What will be the product?[VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_taimu_01_03
entries.text: Here we go, Garganacl. Let’s take them with a\nnice, acute Stone Edge![VAR 0x0114(0025)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_rehoru_01_01
entries.text: History is filled with betrayals. Don’t let your\nguard down—especially when all is going well.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_rehoru_01_02
entries.text: I’m not particularly fond of all this high-tech stuff\nbut...do your thing, technology![VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_rehoru_01_03
entries.text: Feel the power of a deeply held grudge! If I’m\nlucky, this will even lower your Sp. Def.[VAR 0x0114(0027)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_mimoza_01_01
entries.text: Ugh. I’m gonna lose! I can’t believe this![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_mimoza_01_02
entries.text: It’s your time to shine, my lovely Toxapex![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_mimoza_01_03
entries.text: Here’s your treatment, but you’re not gonna like\nit! Too much medicine is poisonous, after all![VAR 0x0114(0028)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sawaro_01_01
entries.text: These muscles of mine will see me through!\nStand firm, Saguaro—you’ve got this.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sawaro_01_02
entries.text: We won’t lose this battle, and we won’t lose in\nloveliness, either. Hatterene, Terastallize![VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sawaro_01_03
entries.text: How about an enchanting kiss to drain your\nPokémon’s life-force away?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_zinia_01_01
entries.text: Boy, I sure am glad to see you haven’t changed.\nYou’re pushing my back up against the wall![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_zinia_01_02
entries.text: Time to check some output levels! Here comes\nmy Tera Orb![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_zinia_01_03
entries.text: Come on, Farigiraf! Let’s toss ’em around using\nsome telekinesis![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_seizi_01_01
entries.text: Could this be the end of the line for me?\nMon dernier Pokémon! You’re my last hope![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_seizi_01_02
entries.text: I’ll give you a little peek at dear Salvatore’s\nbrillantes capacités![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_seizi_01_03
entries.text: Charge, Raichu! Let the lightning fall![VAR 0x0114(0026)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_rival_01_kusa_01
entries.text: Well, that stinks, but I’m still having fun! And\nwe’re only now getting to the best part![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_rival_01_kusa_03

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_kusa_01
entries.text: To think you have grown this strong... But it’s\nnot over for me yet, you know.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_kusa_02
entries.text: Time for this old director to show what he can\ndo. Marvel at this shining Terastallization![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_clavel_01_kusa_03
entries.text: Now, my good Skeledirge—a nice, strong\nShadow Ball, if you please![VAR 0x0114(000A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_dragon_01_01
entries.text: A painting isn’t finished until the final brush\nstroke. Let’s complete our work together![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_dragon_01_02
entries.text: It is time to don the crown of dragons! Let your\ncolor blot out all else![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_dragon_01_03
entries.text: Pardon us for backing into you! Baxcalibur, use\nGlaive Rush![VAR 0x0114(0012)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_chairperson_01_01
entries.text: Hah! Ha ha ha ha ha ha! It’s not checkmate just\nyet, my friend![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_chairperson_01_02
entries.text: Become the light that shines on all who reach\nthe pinnacle, Kingambit.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_chairperson_01_03
entries.text: Witness the blinding light that shines down from\nhigh above![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_jimen_01_01
entries.text: I like battlin’ you, kiddo. I can go all out without\nworrying about breakin’ you![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_jimen_01_02
entries.text: Let’s have a little more fun! Go on, Clodsire!\nShake things up a bit![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_jimen_01_03
entries.text: Hope you’ve braced yourself, kiddo—I’m about\nto rock your world![VAR 0x0114(0013)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_hagane_01_01
entries.text: You haven’t won yet! I’m going to de-feet you,\nyou’ll see![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_hagane_01_02
entries.text: It’s time to get dressed up all pretty and steely,\nTinkie![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_e4_hagane_01_03
entries.text: This move hits HARD! Hope you’re ready![VAR 0x0114(0014)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_honoo4_01_01
entries.text: Sooo, I’ve got... Ack! I’ve only got one Pokémon\nleft![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_honoo4_01_02
entries.text: Terastallize at high heat! Burn ’em and steam ’em,\nBlaziken![VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_honoo4_01_03
entries.text: Have a mouthful of this spicy move! And don’t be\nsalty if you lose, eh?[VAR 0x0114(0047)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_hagane4_01_01
entries.text: I’m at a disadvantage...but my resolve to win\nremains firm. Let us proceed.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_hagane4_01_03
entries.text: Time to pile on the pressure. Don’t resent me for\nit—resent your Pokémon’s HP instead.[VAR 0x0114(0048)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_fairy4_01_01
entries.text: I don’t mind if you push me hard. I’ll push back\njust as hard to beat you![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_fairy4_01_02
entries.text: Here, have a great big Terastal heart! I’ll share\nthis cuteness with you![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_fairy4_01_03
entries.text: Do it, Excadrill! Captivate ’em with your super\ncute moves![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_dragon4_01_01
entries.text: That one stung real good, bud! The way it oughta\nsting in an all-out battle![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_dragon4_01_02
entries.text: Now watch this dragon’s blood boil! Show ’em\nwho’s in control![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_dragon4_01_03
entries.text: Can’t have that blood all boiled up for nothin’.\nGet ready for an onslaught—this won’t be pretty![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sister_01_01
entries.text: Always pushing people into corners—I’m gonna\nwipe that smirk off your face, you’ll see![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sister_01_02
entries.text: Don’t think you can steal the spotlight from me!\nTime for some Tera action![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_sister_01_03
entries.text: Don’t be shy—let me stir things up for you![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_brother_01_01
entries.text: Aw, man, that bites... But I’m still having a blast!\nTime to turn the tables![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_brother_01_02
entries.text: These feelings never change... And I’ll put them\nall into Terastallizing right here, right now![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_brother_01_03
entries.text: I’m gonna go all out with this! Let’s show ’em\nwhat we can do together, Hydrapple![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_shiano_01_01
entries.text: You’re better than I thought. This is starting to\nget interesting![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_shiano_01_02
entries.text: Far be it from me to disappoint our audience.\nI think I’ll try something fun![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_club_shiano_01_03
entries.text: How about THIS move? Don’t let it overwhelm\nyou, now![VAR 0x0114(004B)]

entries.label: msg_btl_talk_kirafuroru_02_01_01
entries.text: What on earth is that energy?! It...it couldn’t be?![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
